title: Positive-degree subset Cech row primitive with zero extension
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, X=\operatorname{Spec}(A) [def-pc-scheme], r a natural number, f:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to A, and D_S=D(\prod_{i\in S}f_i). Let J be an integer-indexed cochain complex of structure-sheaf modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Supply the inclusions D_S\subseteq D_{S\setminus\{j\}} and arithmetic transports he for deletion, as in the subset differential. Fix n\in\mathbf Z and k\geq1, with J^{n+1-k} injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For every family c_S\in\Gamma(D_S,J^{n+2-|S|}), indexed by nonempty subsets, assume its signed restriction sum is zero on every subset of size k+2, with deletion sign (-1)^{|\{i\in S:i<j\}|} and empty deletions zero. There exists a family b_S\in\Gamma(D_S,J^{n+1-|S|}) that is zero unless |S|=k, and whose signed restriction sum on every subset of size k+1 equals c_S, using he at degree n for the primitive and at degree n+1 for the cocycle. No differential of J or total complex is involved.

source.place: Tags 01EP and 01FM; Tag 08C1, first paragraph, positive horizontal row exactness

proof.text: Set q=n+1-k. Define a fixed-coefficient family by applying the functorial eqToHom section cast to c on cardinality k+1 and zero elsewhere. On cardinality k+2 each deletion has cardinality k+1. Cast the given cocycle equation to q, distribute over the finite sum and scalar signs, and use restriction naturality and composition of equality casts. This proves the fixed-coefficient cocycle equation. Equality casts are identity, injective, and inverse under equality elimination.
Apply fixed-coefficient principal-open subset exactness to the injective module J.X q, obtaining a primitive b-prime on nonempty subsets with its differential equation on cardinality k+1.

Define b on cardinality k by casting b-prime from q to n+1-card S and define it as zero elsewhere. The support assertion follows by the negative branch of this definition. On cardinality k+1 each deletion has cardinality k. Cast the desired equation to q; commute the cast through each restriction and deletion transport and cancel the inverse cast on b-prime. The primitive equation gives the transported equality, and injectivity of the equality cast gives the original equality. Empty covers and high degrees are included without a nonemptiness assumption on the index set.

theorem principalOpenCech_subset_row_primitive
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (J : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let D : Finset (Fin r) → (Spec (.of A)).Opens :=
      fun S ↦ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (∏ j ∈ S, f j)
    ∀ (hle : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin r)) (j : Fin r), D S ≤ D (S.erase j))
      (he : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin r)) (j : Fin r), j ∈ S → ∀ n : ℤ,
        n + 1 - ((S.erase j).card : ℤ) = n + 1 + 1 - (S.card : ℤ))
      (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → Injective (J.X (n + 1 - (k : ℤ))) →
      ∀ c : (∀ S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty},
        (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (J.X (n + 1 + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.obj (op (D S.val))),
      (∀ S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty}, S.val.card = k + 2 →
        (∑ j : S.val, if h : (S.val.erase j.val).Nonempty then
            (-1 : A) ^ ((S.val.filter (fun i ↦ i < j.val)).card) •
              (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (J.X (n + 1 + 1 + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.map
                (homOfLE (hle S.val j.val)).op
                ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map
                  (eqToHom (congrArg J.X (he S.val j.val j.property (n + 1))))).hom.app
                    (op (D (S.val.erase j.val))) (c ⟨S.val.erase j.val, h⟩))
          else 0) = 0) →
      ∃ b : (∀ S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty},
        (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (J.X (n + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.obj
          (op (D S.val))),
        (∀ S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty}, S.val.card ≠ k → b S = 0) ∧
        (∀ S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty}, S.val.card = k + 1 →
          (∑ j : S.val, if h : (S.val.erase j.val).Nonempty then
            (-1 : A) ^ ((S.val.filter (fun i ↦ i < j.val)).card) •
              (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (J.X (n + 1 + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.map
                (homOfLE (hle S.val j.val)).op
                ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map
                  (eqToHom (congrArg J.X (he S.val j.val j.property n)))).hom.app
                    (op (D (S.val.erase j.val))) (b ⟨S.val.erase j.val, h⟩))
          else 0) = c S)
